header.title: Topbar
header.subtitle: The persistent header rendered at the top of every dashboard page. Composed of a page title, breadcrumbs, search input, language switcher, notification bell, theme toggle, and a user dropdown.

schema.title: Visual schema
schema.description: The topbar is divided into two sides separated by a flex spacer. Left side: page context. Right side: global controls.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: Each region of the topbar and the component that drives it.

extensionPoints.title: Extension points
extensionPoints.description: Three areas in the current implementation are intentional stubs — documented here for teams extending the template.

titleDerivation.title: Page title derivation
titleDerivation.description: The page title is derived from the current pathname using src/lib/route-info.ts — the single source of truth for route labels.

props.title: Props
props.description: Topbar takes no props. All state (user, theme, locale) is consumed from global stores and hooks.

region1.name: Title + Breadcrumbs
region1.description: Page title derived from getRouteLabel(pathname). Breadcrumbs derived automatically from getRouteAncestors(pathname). Both read sidebar.config.ts as the single source of truth.

region2.name: Search input
region2.description: Compact search field with a Search icon. Currently visual only — see Extension points.

region3.name: Language switcher
region3.description: Compact locale picker. Persists the selected locale in the NEXT_LOCALE cookie via next-intl.

region4.name: Notification bell
region4.description: Bell icon with a badge showing the unread count. Currently hardcoded to 3 — see Extension points.

region5.name: Theme toggle
region5.description: Switches between light and dark mode. See the Theme Toggle page for full documentation.

region6.name: User dropdown
region6.description: Avatar, first name, and a dropdown with Profile, Settings, and Sign out. Profile and Settings are currently no-ops — see Extension points.

extensionPoints.notification: Notification count is hardcoded to 3. Replace with a hook (e.g. useUnreadNotifications()) that fetches the count from your backend.
extensionPoints.search: Search input is visual only. Wire onChange to a search state, then route to a results page or show inline results.
extensionPoints.profileSettings: Profile and Settings menu items call onClick with no effect. Replace with router.push(routes.settings) or a modal trigger.

titleDerivation.note: getRouteLabel reads sidebar.config.ts — adding a route to the sidebar config makes its title appear in the topbar automatically.
